svg.title: What a SIXEL codec does
svg.desc: A seven by twelve pixel tree is encoded into a short line of text, the SIXEL stream #1_s}~}s_-#1!7@$#2??O]O, and decoded back into the same pixels.
svg.text: An encoder turns pixels into text; a decoder turns it back.
The text in the middle is a SIXEL stream:
Send it to a terminal that understands SIXEL and the terminal
draws the tree. Lesson 0 shows how to read every byte of it.
